policy: Canonical card-rule placeholders encode game semantics, not exact artwork. Pre-release or prototype artwork may be normalized only for the exact source tuples listed here. Literal source appearance remains preserved in source images, raw vision evidence, and each resolution entry; no color/shape-wide inference is authorized.

entries.literalArt: purple square containing a white exclamation mark (vertical bar and detached dot)
evidence: Project-owner follow-up review on 2026-08-22: collected assets may use pre-release artwork that differs visually while retaining the same symbol meaning.
The legacy glyph occupies the non-numeric Burst-result position and introduces a printed additional effect on every listed weapon face.
Later Flamethrower and Plasma Gun faces use the current burstDieAdditionalEffects artwork in the same result/effect syntax.

entries.literalArt: red upright triangle containing an older curved or oblique ammunition-magazine motif
evidence: Project-owner follow-up review on 2026-08-22 identified the reviewed Plasma Gun triangle as an ammunition magazine and probably a die result, and explained that pre-release symbols may retain meaning despite changed art.
The reviewed legacy Plasma Gun and the later same-title Plasma Gun place this red result after the Burst additional-effects result in the same two-result effect trigger.
The legacy Flamethrower face already had this artwork normalized as shootDieAmmoLoss; the same shared-sheet motif appears on Sonic Gun and Mini-Turret in Shoot-result syntax.
